对于一个区间，外部精确地减少到一个鬼顶点，并且显式平方对数取消，留下解析边贡献 $\gamma_E=\log2/4-1/16$。条件循环项具有精确的全支持分解为物理线路和幽灵链接扇区；以边界森林减法的闭合为条件，这些部分定义了剩余对数系数的重正化线和单体-二聚体边界周期的全阶层次结构。第一个完整的增强关联系数以封闭形式进行评估，其线和鬼边界层异常之间具有精确的抵消；根据精确的有限大小概率进行独立重建可恢复已建立的系数 $\gamma_1=0.060020(3)$。

title: Fast free-energy estimation for complex systems with nonreversible simulated tempering
abstract: We discuss free-energy estimation for complex systems using simulated tempering with Wang--Landau-type feedback. We show that introducing nonreversible dynamics in temperature space and multiple temperature updates per step significantly accelerates the convergence of the free-energy estimate. We then apply the algorithm to the three-dimensional Edwards-Anderson spin-glass model. Our results show that the algorithm can precisely estimate the free energy up to a large system size $L \simeq 64$, and that subsequent equilibrium simulated tempering simulations with the estimated free energy can rapidly sample from the Boltzmann distributions over a wide temperature range that covers the spin-glass transition temperature. The convergence time of our algorithm grows much more slowly with system size than that of another known algorithm for on-the-fly free-energy estimation.
summary: 我们讨论了使用 Wang--Landau 型反馈进行模拟回火的复杂系统的自由能估计。我们证明，在温度空间中引入不可逆动力学以及每步的多次温度更新可以显着加速自由能估计的收敛。然后，我们将该算法应用于三维 Edwards-Anderson 自旋玻璃模型。我们的结果表明，该算法可以精确估计高达大系统尺寸 $L \simeq 64$ 的自由能，并且使用估计的自由能进行的后续平衡模拟回火模拟可以在覆盖自旋玻璃转变温度的较宽温度范围内从玻尔兹曼分布中快速采样。与另一种已知的动态自由能估计算法相比，我们算法的收敛时间随着系统规模的增长而增长得慢得多。

title: Classifications in modular restricted Boltzmann machines
abstract: We consider a modular associative neural network made of $L$ Hopfield models (HMs), coupled so that intra-module interactions are Hebbian and inter-module interactions are anti-Hebbian; this competitive coupling is known to endow the network with pattern-disentanglement capabilities. The integral representation of this system coincides with an assembly of $L$ restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) whose hidden layers are coupled, thereby extending the HM-RBM duality to the modular setting. We then train this modular RBM, via one-step contrastive divergence, to perform a classification task in which a query encoded on the visible layers is mapped onto an $L$-tuple of labels read off the hidden layers. When the query is composed of $L$ patterns that are mutually orthogonal on average, we prove that the RBM weights obtained as empirical means over the training dataset, as suggested by the HM-RBM equivalence, constitute a fixed point of the learning dynamics, and we derive an explicit, non-asymptotic bound on the residual drift. We then turn to a harder classification task in which each module is queried with a mixture of $L$ patterns and we show numerically that the same setting for the RBM weights still provides an effective set-up, letting the network jointly classify and disentangle the mixture.
summary:
我们考虑由 $L$ Hopfield 模型（HM）组成的模块化关联神经网络，通过耦合使得模块内交互是赫布式的，而模块间交互是反赫布式的；众所周知，这种竞争性耦合赋予网络模式解缠能力。该系统的积分表示与隐藏层耦合的 $L$ 受限玻尔兹曼机 (RBM) 的集合一致，从而将 HM-RBM 对偶性扩展到模块化设置。然后，我们通过一步对比散度训练这个模块化 RBM，以执行分类任务，其中在可见层上编码的查询被映射到从隐藏层读取的标签的 $L$ 元组上。当查询由平均相互正交的 $L$ 模式组成时，我们证明，如 HM-RBM 等式所示，作为训练数据集上的经验平均值获得的 RBM 权重构成了学习动态的固定点，并且我们得出了残差漂移的显式非渐近界限。

然后，我们转向更难的分类任务，其中每个模块都使用 $L$ 模式的混合进行查询，并且我们以数字方式显示，RBM ​​权重的相同设置仍然提供了有效的设置，让网络对混合物进行联合分类和解开。

title: Grain-boundary segregation delays the onset of plastic flow in nanocrystalline Fe-18Cr-12Ni
abstract: Grain-boundary (GB) segregation in austenitic Fe-Cr-Ni alloys has been studied mainly in irradiated or sensitised material, rarely in the nanocrystalline state. Hybrid molecular dynamics/Monte Carlo (MD/MC) simulations are used to segregate three independent nanocrystalline Fe-18Cr-12Ni polycrystals, which are compared with annealed and random controls on the same microstructures. Ni is depleted at the GB plane and Cr is enriched in the adjacent atomic shell; both directions are established at the production sampling budget and strengthen when one of the three microstructures is sampled further. The Cr enrichment is resolved only against the far-field grain interior; the common partition into face-centred-cubic (fcc) and non-fcc atoms places the enriched shell in its own reference. Under a constant uniaxial stress of 4.6 GPa at 300 K, the segregated polycrystals take about 16% longer than random ones to reach 50% strain; measured against annealed controls, boundary chemistry contributes about two-thirds of this gain and boundary relaxation the rest. The difference arises from a lower strain rate early in plastic flow, with no resolvable change in dislocation content. At a fixed strain rate the segregated state has a 6-7% higher peak stress than its annealed control at 300, 750 and 950 K, and at matched ratios of applied to flow stress the gain is the same at all three temperatures, decreasing only as that ratio rises. Early plastic flow is thus the stage at which GB chemistry acts, and simulated GB composition in nanocrystals depends strongly on the reference region.
summary:
奥氏体 Fe-Cr-Ni 合金中的晶界偏析主要在辐照或敏化材料中进行研究，很少在纳米晶状态下进行研究。使用混合分子动力学/蒙特卡罗 (MD/MC) 模拟来分离三种独立的纳米晶 Fe-18Cr-12Ni 多晶，并将其与相同微观结构的退火和随机对照进行比较。 Ni在GB平面处贫化，Cr在邻近原子壳层处富集；这两个方向都是在生产抽样预算中确定的，并在进一步对三个微观结构之一进行抽样时加强。 Cr 富集仅针对远场颗粒内部进行解析；面心立方 (fcc) 和非 FCC 原子的共同划分将富集壳层置于其自己的参考中。在 300 K、4.6 GPa 的恒定单轴应力下，偏析多晶达到 50% 应变所需的时间比随机多晶长约 16%；根据退火对照进行测量，边界化学贡献了约三分之二的增益，其余部分为边界弛豫。差异是由于塑性流动早期的应变率较低，位错含量没有可分辨的变化。

在固定应变速率下，偏析状态的峰值应力比其在 300、750 和 950 K 下的退火控制高出 6-7%，并且在施加到流动应力的匹配比率下，增益在所有三个温度下都是相同的，仅随着该比率的升高而降低。因此，早期塑性流动是 GB 化学作用的阶段，并且纳米晶体中模拟的 GB 成分很大程度上取决于参考区域。

title: Nonlinear Curvature-Free Periodic Folding in Origami via Symmetry Classification of Linear Modes
abstract: Broadly studied origami crease patterns such as the Miura-ori are capable of rigid folding that maintains their spatial periodicity. However, periodic crease patterns generically require additional creases and fold into quasi-cylindrical shapes. Here, using group theory, we show that the folding properties of such sheets are largely determined by their spatial symmetries, known as layer groups. Within each symmetry class, the allowed linear shape-periodic modes of sheets are constrained and classified by the irreducible representation they belong to. Such classification further gives a sufficient condition, containing a symmetry constraint and a topological constraint, for the existence of a nonlinear strain mode. In this way, familiar special cases are placed within a unified framework that connects symmetry, network topology, and deployability. Finally, we turn our classification results into a predictive design principle that enables the rapid design of novel sheets with prescribed properties.
summary: 经过广泛研究的折纸折痕图案（例如 Miura-ori）能够进行刚性折叠，从而保持其空间周期性。然而，周期性折痕图案通常需要额外的折痕并折叠成准圆柱形形状。在这里，我们使用群论表明，此类纸张的折叠特性很大程度上取决于其空间对称性（称为层组）。在每个对称类中，片材允许的线性形状周期模式受到它们所属的不可约表示的约束和分类。这种分类进一步给出了非线性应变模式存在的充分条件，包含对称约束和拓扑约束。通过这种方式，熟悉的特殊情况被放置在连接对称性、网络拓扑和可部署性的统一框架内。最后，我们将分类结果转化为预测设计原理，从而能够快速设计具有规定属性的新型板材。

title: Algebraic Tensor Network Renormalization and Holographic duality
abstract: Emergent generalized symmetries and the holographic principle play very important roles in understanding quantum phase transitions. In recent years, tensor-network renormalization with generalized symmetry and the corresponding fixed-point tensor formulation have been proposed as a discrete spacetime framework for reformulating conformal field theory. Nevertheless, a complete holographic formulation within this framework is still lacking, and the current formulation does not directly accommodate sector partition functions that are modular covariant in general. In this work, we formulate $\mathcal{R}$-TNR, which builds the categorical constraints of a fusion category $\mathcal{R}$ into local tensor spaces and preserves these constraints under Loop-TNR. For suitable choices of $\mathcal{R}$, the initial tensors constructed here flow under $\mathcal{R}$-Loop-TNR to stable gapless fixed points. In the Ising, tricritical Ising, and three-state Potts conformal field theory examples, a broad range of initial parameters leads to the same gapless fixed point in each example. The method resolves conformal towers by anyon sector and yields scaling dimensions, conformal spins, and magnitudes of sector-resolved structure constants with extremely high accuracy compared to previous methods. These results realize a topological bootstrap based on stable symmetry-topological-order in which finite categorical and geometric input, together with an initial tensor that need not be fine-tuned, suffices to recover the infrared conformal field theory and its sector-resolved conformal data.
summary:
涌现的广义对称性和全息原理在理解量子相变中发挥着非常重要的作用。近年来，具有广义对称性的张量网络重整化和相应的定点张量公式被提出作为重新表述共形场论的离散时空框架。然而，该框架内仍然缺乏完整的全息公式，并且当前的公式不能直接适应一般为模协变的扇区划分函数。在这项工作中，我们制定了 $\mathcal{R}$-TNR，它将融合类别 $\mathcal{R}$ 的分类约束构建到局部张量空间中，并在 Loop-TNR 下保留这些约束。对于 $\mathcal{R}$ 的合适选择，此处构造的初始张量在 $\mathcal{R}$-Loop-TNR 下流向稳定的无间隙固定点。在伊辛、三临界伊辛和三态波茨共形场论示例中，广泛的初始参数在每个示例中导致相同的无间隙固定点。

该方法通过任意子扇区解析共形塔，并产生缩放尺寸、共形自旋和扇区解析结构常数的大小，与以前的方法相比，具有极高的精度。这些结果实现了基于稳定对称拓扑序的拓扑引导，其中有限的分类和几何输入以及不需要微调的初始张量足以恢复红外共形场理论及其扇区解析的共形数据。

title: All-Orders Classical Soft Graviton Theorems in the Newtonian Limit and Beyond
abstract: The classical soft graviton theorem aims to determine certain terms in the early- and late-time tails of the gravitational waveform produced in a scattering process, using only the asymptotic momenta of the scattered objects. In this paper we find an infinite series of leading-logarithmic tail terms in the Newtonian limit, where the incoming and outgoing particles move slowly, but the scattering itself can be violent. The all-orders conjecture of Alessio, Di Vecchia and Heissenberg agrees with our results for two-particle scattering, but does not hold in general when the initial or final state contains three or more particles. We also propose an all-orders conjecture for these tails beyond the Newtonian limit, but do not prove it. Nevertheless, the conjecture passes several nontrivial consistency checks.
summary: 经典的软引力子定理旨在仅使用散射物体的渐近动量来确定散射过程中产生的引力波形的早期和晚期尾部中的某些项。在本文中，我们发现了牛顿极限中的无限级数前导对数尾项，其中传入和传出的粒子移动缓慢，但散射本身可能很剧烈。 Alessio、Di Vecchia 和 Heissenberg 的全阶猜想与我们的二粒子散射结果一致，但当初始或最终状态包含三个或更多粒子时，一般不成立。我们还提出了这些超出牛顿极限的尾部的全序猜想，但没有证明。尽管如此，该猜想还是通过了几个重要的一致性检查。

title: A New Entropy Puzzle in ABJM
abstract: We point out a puzzle about BPS black holes in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$: the entropy grows when $k$ increases although the number of gauge-invariant operators in the dual conformal field theory that can contribute to the entropy grows as $k$ decreases, due to the presence of monopole operators. Analyzing the superconformal index of ABJM, we show that the same puzzle exists for finite $N$ in the large charge limit. We propose a resolution based on an increasing number of trace relations as $k$ decreases, which dominates over the other effect. We argue that this mostly affects fortuitous operators and we provide an explicit example of a fortuitous operator that disappears at small $k$.
summary: 我们指出了 AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ 中关于 BPS 黑洞的一个难题：当 $k$ 增加时，熵会增加，尽管由于单极子算子的存在，双共形场理论中可以贡献熵的规范不变算子的数量会随着 $k$ 的减少而增加。分析 ABJM 的超共形指数，我们表明对于大电荷极限下的有限 $N$ 也存在同样的难题。我们提出了一种基于随着 $k$ 减少而增加的跟踪关系数量的解决方案，这比其他效果占主导地位。我们认为这主要影响偶然运算符，并且我们提供了一个在小 $k$ 时消失的偶然运算符的明确示例。

title: Checking the Schwinger-Dyson equation in the purely open matrix-tensor model
abstract: We test the proposed matrix-tensor description of three-dimensional gravity using a Schwinger-Dyson relation in its purely open sector. We enumerate and classify the topological contributions to a cylinder amplitude. Under a proposed counting prescription motivated by Virasoro TQFT, we find agreement with the conjectured unit difference between the numbers of contributing manifolds associated to the two interaction terms in the potential. By contrast, counting all inequivalent surface embeddings separately would instead give a mismatch. This comparison highlights the importance of specifying the set of bulk topologies to be included in the gravitational path integral.
summary: 我们使用 Schwinger-Dyson 关系在其纯开扇区中测试了所提出的三维重力矩阵张量描述。我们对圆柱振幅的拓扑贡献进行枚举和分类。根据 Virasoro TQFT 提出的计数处方，我们发现与势中两个相互作用项相关的贡献流形数量之间的推测单位差一致。相比之下，单独计算所有不等价的表面嵌入反而会产生不匹配。这种比较强调了指定要包含在引力路径积分中的体拓扑集的重要性。

title: The Back-to-Back Plateau of the Energy-Energy Correlator from Weak to Strong Coupling
abstract: The back-to-back limit of the energy-energy correlator (EEC) exhibits a finite plateau, capturing the evolution from perturbative soft-collinear radiation at weak coupling to string dynamics at strong coupling. At weak coupling, we resum its leading and next-to-leading-power logarithms through N$^3$LL in $\mathcal N=4$ SYM, including non-planar contributions. Combining this weak-coupling endpoint with bootstrap and strong-coupling data, we construct an interpolation for the plateau height from weak to strong coupling. The calculation uses a human-in-the-loop agentic workflow.
summary: 能量-能量相关器 (EEC) 的背靠背极限表现出有限平台，捕获从弱耦合时的微扰软共线辐射到强耦合时的弦动力学的演化。在弱耦合时，我们通过 $\mathcal N=4$ SYM 中的 N$^3$LL 恢复其领先和次领先幂对数，包括非平面贡献。将此弱耦合端点与自举和强耦合数据相结合，我们构建了从弱耦合到强耦合的平台高度的插值。该计算使用人机交互代理工作流程。

title: Deriving the $\text{AdS}_3\times\text{S}^3\times \text{T}^4$ Quantum Spectral Curve II: T-system and QSC
abstract: We complete the systematic derivation of the Quantum Spectral Curve (QSC) for strings on $\text{AdS}_3\times\text{S}^3\times \text{T}^4$ with pure Ramond--Ramond (RR) flux, building on the extended Y-system obtained in our preceding paper. We establish the precise relation between the two formalisms of the Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz and the QSC, derive the previously conjectured QSC, and, along the way, uncover additional relations satisfied by its solutions. Our analysis also clarifies how massless excitations, although not explicit among the basic QSC building blocks, are encoded in their analytic structure. The derivation culminates in the so-called $\mathbf{P}{\mu}$-system, a compact formulation of the QSC in terms of a small set of functions and their analytic continuations.
summary: 我们在上一篇论文中获得的扩展 Y 系统的基础上，用纯 Ramond--Ramond (RR) 通量完成了 $\text{AdS}_3\times\text{S}^3\times \text{T}^4$ 上字符串的量子谱曲线 (QSC) 的系统推导。我们建立了热力学 Bethe Ansatz 和 QSC 两种形式之间的精确关系，推导了之前猜想的 QSC，并在此过程中发现了其解满足的其他关系。我们的分析还阐明了无质量激励如何编码在其分析结构中，尽管在基本 QSC 构建块中并不明确。推导最终形成所谓的 $\mathbf{P}{\mu}$ 系统，这是 QSC 的一个紧凑公式，由一小组函数及其解析延拓组成。

title: Localizing $\mathcal{N}=(2,0)$ $AdS_3$ solutions of M-theory
abstract: We apply equivariant localization to supersymmetric $AdS_3\times M_8$ solutions of eleven-dimensional supergravity, dual to two-dimensional $\mathcal N=(2,0)$ SCFTs. We construct equivariantly closed polyforms encoding the magnetic flux and its dual, calibrated M2-branes and the warped volume, reducing protected observables to fixed point data of the $U(1)$ R-symmetry action. We apply the framework to $S^4$ bundles over coassociative four-cycles and $S^2$ bundles over compact six-manifolds, obtaining topological formulae for leading central charges and gravitational anomalies in terms of quantized fluxes and topological data. We recover the known results for $T^2\times KE_4$ solutions and construct a compact numerical solution with quantized flux that lies outside the known polynomial branch.
summary: 我们将等变定位应用于十一维超重力的超对称 $AdS_3\times M_8$ 解，对偶到二维 $\mathcal N=(2,0)$ SCFT。我们构建了等变闭合多形体，对磁通量及其双校准 M2 膜和扭曲体积进行编码，将受保护的可观测量减少到 $U(1)$ R 对称作用的定点数据。我们将该框架应用于共关联四周期上的 $S^4$ 束和紧凑六流形上的 $S^2$ 束，获得了量子通量和拓扑数据方面的主导中心电荷和引力异常的拓扑公式。我们恢复 $T^2\times KE_4$ 解的已知结果，并构造一个具有位于已知多项式分支之外的量化通量的紧凑数值解。

title: The s-Rule from Geometry
abstract: String Theory provides powerful tools for constructing and studying five-dimensional Quantum Field Theories, notably through geometric engineering and five-brane webs. Understanding how these two descriptions are related in the presence of 7-branes requires incorporating the s-rule into the geometry. To address this question, we focus on basic three-legged five-brane webs ending on 7-branes. Building on the local M-theory description of five-branes ending on 7-branes, we consider triangular toric diagrams with a single non-primitive edge. We show that the corresponding local complex-structure deformation is well defined on the overlaps with the neighboring toric patches, while the corresponding gluing map remains well behaved as a function of the holomorphic coordinates throughout the neighboring patches precisely when the s-rule is satisfied. At saturation, the geometry is a T-cone and the 7-brane deformation becomes its Q-Gorenstein smoothing. Our results thus identify the s-rule with the obstruction to globalizing the local 7-brane deformation and provide a direct geometric link between T-cones and five-branes ending on 7-branes.
summary: 弦理论为构建和研究五维量子场论提供了强大的工具，特别是通过几何工程和五膜网。要理解这两种描述在 7-膜存在时如何相关，需要将 s 规则合并到几何中。为了解决这个问题，我们重点关注以 7 膜结尾的基本三足五膜网。基于以 7 膜结尾的 5 膜的局部 M 理论描述，我们考虑具有单个非原始边的三角环面图。我们表明，相应的局部复杂结构变形在与相邻环面贴片的重叠处得到了很好的定义，而当满足 s 规则时，相应的粘合图作为整个相邻贴片的全纯坐标的函数仍然表现良好。饱和时，几何形状是 T 锥体，7 膜变形变成 Q-Gorenstein 平滑。因此，我们的结果确定了阻碍局部 7 膜变形的 s 规则，并提供了 T 锥体和以 7 膜结尾的五膜之间的直接几何联系。

title: Interacting multicomponent $SU(N)$ magnets
abstract: We study magnets composed of molecules with atoms interacting via $SU(N)$-invariant two-body interactions. Atoms carry states transforming in generically different irreducible representations of $SU(N)$, and the interaction strength between atoms depends on the specific atoms involved. We derive the thermodynamics of these magnets in the mean-field approach, and find that they can exhibit mixed ferro-antiferromagnetic behavior. We present a full analysis of the simplest nontrivial case of molecules consisting of two atoms in the spin-$j$ representation of $SU(2)$, which generalizes conventional magnetic systems, and derive its phase structure and transitions.
summary: 我们研究由分子和原子通过 $SU(N)$ 不变的二体相互作用相互作用组成的磁体。原子携带状态以 $SU(N)$ 的一般不同不可约表示形式变换，并且原子之间的相互作用强度取决于所涉及的特定原子。我们通过平均场方法推导了这些磁体的热力学，并发现它们可以表现出混合的铁反铁磁行为。我们对由 $SU(2)$ 的自旋 $j$ 表示中的两个原子组成的分子的最简单的非平凡情况进行了全面分析，它概括了传统的磁系统，并推导了其相结构和转变。

title: Non-invertible SPT phases from fusion rings via Tannaka duality
abstract: In a (1+1)-dimensional QFT with non-invertible symmetry, the fusion rules of topological lines are often the most accessible data, yet they do not fully determine whether the symmetry is anomaly-free, i.e. whether it admits trivially gapped phases. Such phases are characterized by fiber functors of the corresponding fusion category. Building on Tannaka duality, we extract fiber functors from the fusion ring alone by solving simultaneously for monoidal structure maps and tensor automorphisms. This allows us to find categorifications admitting a fiber functor without solving the pentagon equations directly. We test this procedure on the known Tambara--Yamagami ring of $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$. Our main result concerns the rank-11 fusion ring shared by the representation categories of the two extraspecial groups of order 27, which has a multiplicity 3 channel and is relevant to self-triality. In both cases we find more than one fiber functor, i.e. several non-invertible SPT phases. We use the explicit data of these fiber functors to derive the $F$-symbols of the two representation categories in a compact form depending on a non-degenerate alternating bicharacter and an invertible object $\epsilon$. Using the reconstructed data, we compute the anomalous algebra on the interface between two different SPT phases.
summary:
在具有不可逆对称性的 (1+1) 维 QFT 中，拓扑线的融合规则通常是最容易获得的数据，但它们并不能完全确定对称性是否无异常，即是否允许平凡间隙相。这些阶段的特征是相应融合类别的光纤函子。基于 Tannaka 对偶性，我们通过同时求解幺半群结构图和张量自同构，仅从融合环中提取纤维函子。这使我们能够找到接纳纤维函子的分类，而无需直接求解五边形方程。我们在已知的 $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$ 环上测试这个过程。我们的主要结果涉及两个 27 阶超特殊群的表示类别共享的 11 阶融合环，其具有多重性 3 通道并且与自我尝试相关。在这两种情况下，我们都发现了多个光纤函子，即几个不可逆的 SPT 相。

我们使用这些纤维函子的显式数据，根据非退化交替双字符和可逆对象 $\epsilon$ 以紧凑的形式导出两个表示类别的 $F$ 符号。使用重建的数据，我们计算两个不同 SPT 相之间的界面上的反常代数。

title: Multi-Point Affine Bialgebras for AdS/CFT Integrability
abstract: In this work, we revisit the analytical structure of the classical affine Lie bialgebra underlying the integrable structures of AdS/CFT worldsheet scattering and the one-dimensional Hubbard model. Earlier work showed that the algebraic relations implied two singularity locations in the evaluation parameter plane besides the common expansion points infinity and zero for Laurent polynomials forming the basis for loop and affine algebras. Our aim is to formulate these singularities rigorously using meromorphic functions rather than by expansion into geometric series. We thus carefully analyse the analytical structure of the affine bialgebra relations in the complex plane paying attention to potential restrictions and extensions due to the additional singularities. As a first attempt with some shortcomings, we reformulate the affine bialgebra relations with the extra singularities serving as the expansion points for Laurent polynomials. We finally overcome the remaining issues by proposing three-point and four-point affine algebras for the rational and trigonometric cases. With a suitable choice of basis for meromorphic functions on the Riemann sphere with several punctures based on Krichever-Novikov algebras, we show that the multi-point affine algebras form consistent quasi-triangular Lie bialgebras.
summary:
在这项工作中，我们重新审视了 AdS/CFT 世界表散射可积结构和一维 Hubbard 模型背后的经典仿射李双代数的解析结构。早期的工作表明，除了形成循环代数和仿射代数基础的洛朗多项式的公共展开点无穷大和零之外，代数关系还暗示了评估参数平面中的两个奇点位置。我们的目标是使用亚纯函数严格地表述这些奇点，而不是通过展开为几何级数。因此，我们仔细分析了复平面中仿射双代数关系的解析结构，注意由于额外的奇点而导致的潜在限制和扩展。作为存在一些缺点的第一次尝试，我们重新表述了仿射双代数关系，并将额外奇点作为洛朗多项式的展开点。我们最终通过针对有理和三角情况提出三点和四点仿射代数来克服剩余的问题。

通过在基于 Krichever-Novikov 代数的具有多个穿孔的黎曼球上适当选择亚纯函数的基，我们证明多点仿射代数形成一致的拟三角形李双代数。

title: Generalised entanglement wedges in three dimensions
abstract: Generalized entanglement wedges (GWs), proposed by Bousso and Penington for gravitating regions in general spacetimes, share many properties of ordinary entanglement wedges, including nesting, monotonicity and strong subadditivity of their generalized entropies. In AdS/CFT, the corresponding properties of entanglement wedges are consequences of the structure of the dual CFT. In this paper we ask whether the properties of GWs have a similar origin. We explore this question in vacuum AdS$_3$ at leading order in $G$. We first show that every GW on a static slice is a union of geodesically convex regions. Each such region is an intersection of ordinary entanglement wedges, so every GW is built from unions and intersections of entanglement wedges. We then use the Crofton formula of integral geometry to write the perimeter of a convex region as the measure of the set of geodesics that intersect it. In AdS$_3$ every geodesic is the Ryu--Takayanagi surface of a boundary interval, so this measure can be written in terms of the von Neumann entropies of CFT intervals. Strong subadditivity of the CFT entropy guarantees that the measure is positive. Monotonicity and strong subadditivity of GWs then follow from simple inequalities between sets of geodesics. The strong subadditivity of GWs is therefore a direct consequence of strong subadditivity on the boundary. Our results further suggest that GWs correspond to subsystems of the CFT that are more general than boundary subregions.
summary:
广义纠缠楔（GW）由 Bousso 和 Penington 提出，用于一般时空中的引力区域，它具有普通纠缠楔的许多性质，包括嵌套、单调性和广义熵的强次可加性。在 AdS/CFT 中，纠缠楔的相应性质是双 CFT 结构的结果。在本文中，我们询问引力波的属性是否具有相似的起源。我们以 $G$ 的领先顺序在真空 AdS$_3$ 中探索这个问题。我们首先证明静态切片上的每个 GW 都是测地凸区域的并集。每个这样的区域都是普通纠缠楔的交集，因此每个引力波都是由纠缠楔的并集和交集构建的。然后，我们使用积分几何的克罗夫顿公式将凸区域的周长写为与其相交的测地线集合的度量。在 AdS$_3$ 中，每个测地线都是边界区间的 Ryu--Takayanagi 曲面，因此该度量可以用 CFT 区间的冯诺依曼熵来编写。 CFT 熵的强次可加性保证了该测度是正的。

引力波的单调性和强次可加性是由测地线组之间的简单不等式得出的。因此，引力波的强次可加性是边界上强次可加性的直接结果。我们的结果进一步表明，GW 对应于 CFT 的子系统，比边界子区域更通用。

title: Geometry of massive loops in gravitational scattering: Maximal cut, Riemann's bilinear relations and genus drop
abstract: We study a representative two-loop family of worldline quantum field theory integrals relevant for classical gravitational scattering with a massive mediator and investigate the geometric structure of its maximal cut. We find that, unlike the massless case, the massive loops already give rise to an elliptic maximal cut at two loops, which degenerates into a nodal curve in the massless limit and in the static limit. In the global Baikov representation, two successive integrations reduce the maximal cut to a period of an elliptic curve. We further establish five primary consequences of this study: (a) The integration-by-parts method generates five master integrals, which, under reflection, split into a three-dimensional elliptic block and a two-dimensional polylog block. We derive the differential equation in two ways, one by Laporta reduction and subsequently by intersection theory in two cocycle bases, and construct the rational map between them. (b) The period matrices in arbitrary dimension have been computed in terms of Appell and Beta functions. Furthermore, we derive twisted Riemann period relations that yield nine quadratic identities among them. (c) We study the global monodromy relation of the differential system that satisfies Riemann's bilinear relation. (d) We explicitly derive the function space of the iterated integrals in terms of elliptic multiple polylogs. (e) In impact-parameter space, the Fourier-transformed cut is a Bessel-twisted differential on the elliptic curve, which we show has extra involution symmetries. Thus, the parity of the differential further decides which quotient - rational or elliptic its periods live on. All results presented concern the maximal cut and, therefore, the homogeneous solutions, but they open an important pathway to tackling the full massive two-loop integral.
summary:
我们研究了与具有大质量介体的经典引力散射相关的世界线量子场论积分的代表性二环族，并研究了其最大切割的几何结构。我们发现，与无质量情况不同，大环已经在两个环处产生了椭圆最大切割，在无质量极限和静态极限下退化为节点曲线。在全局 Baikov 表示中，两次连续积分将最大割减至椭圆曲线的周期。我们进一步建立了这项研究的五个主要结果：（a）分部分积分方法生成五个主积分，它们在反射下分裂成三维椭圆块和二维多对数块。我们用两种方法推导微分方程，一种是通过拉波尔塔约简，然后是通过两个余循环基的交集理论，并构造它们之间的有理映射。 (b) 任意维度的周期矩阵已根据 Appell 和 Beta 函数计算。此外，我们推导出扭曲的黎曼周期关系，其中产生九个二次恒等式。

(c) 我们研究了满足黎曼双线性关系的微分系统的全局单向关系。 (d) 我们根据椭圆多重多对数明确导出迭代积分的函数空间。 (e) 在冲击参数空间中，傅里叶变换切割是椭圆曲线上的贝塞尔扭曲微分，我们证明它具有额外的对合对称性。因此，微分的奇偶性进一步决定了其周期存在的商——有理商还是椭圆商。提出的所有结果都涉及最大切割，因此也涉及齐次解，但它们为解决完整的大规模二环积分开辟了一条重要途径。

title: The QCD phase diagram and critical end point at finite magnetic field from holography with neural networks
abstract: We study the magnetic-field-driven critical end point (CEP) of the QCD thermal transition at zero baryon chemical potential using a five-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton (EMD) model. We calibrate the model to lattice entropy at zero and finite magnetic fields using a neural-network formulation of holographic radial evolution. As the magnetic field increases, the thermal transition changes from a crossover to a first-order transition. The merger of temperature turning points, a divergent specific heat, and a vanishing squared sound speed identify $(eB_c,T_c)\simeq(7.22\,\mathrm{GeV}^{2},95.9\,\mathrm{MeV})$. The transition-region inflection of $s/T^3$ defines the crossover temperature, while an equal-pressure Maxwell construction determines the first-order coexistence line. The two lines meet at the CEP. The change of transition order agrees qualitatively with lattice results. The phase boundary is a prediction of the calibrated model.
summary: 我们使用五维爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-膨胀 (EMD) 模型研究了零重子化学势下 QCD 热转变的磁场驱动临界终点 (CEP)。我们使用全息径向演化的神经网络公式将模型校准到零和有限磁场下的晶格熵。随着磁场的增加，热转变从交叉转变为一阶转变。温度转折点、发散比热和消失平方声速的合并确定为 $(eB_c,T_c)\simeq(7.22\,\mathrm{GeV}^{2},95.9\,\mathrm{MeV})$。 $s/T^3$ 的过渡区域拐点定义了交叉温度，而等压麦克斯韦结构则确定了一阶共存线。两条线在 CEP 处交汇。跃迁级的变化与晶格结果定性一致。相界是校准模型的预测。

title: Quantum Algorithms for Finding Vacua in the ADK Landscape
abstract: We study quantum algorithms for finding a vacuum with a small cosmological constant in the toy model for string Landscape proposed by Arkani-Hamed, Dimopoulos, and Kachru. First, we construct a function-value oracle and use it for Grover search with query complexity $\mathcal{O}(2^{N/2})$, where $N$ is the number of scalar fields. Then, we point out that, by exploiting the linearity of the vacuum energy, the problem can be reduced to a collision problem between two blocks of the bit string. With this structure, we construct two quantum algorithms with query complexity $\mathcal{O}(2^{N/3})$. Compared with the pseudo-polynomial classical algorithm of Denef and Douglas, the quantum algorithms yield a large reduction in computational cost for the physically motivated parameter values.
summary: 我们研究了在 Arkani-Hamed、Dimopoulos 和 Kachru 提出的弦景观玩具模型中寻找具有小宇宙常数的真空的量子算法。首先，我们构造一个函数值预言机并将其用于查询复杂度为 $\mathcal{O}(2^{N/2})$ 的 Grover 搜索，其中 $N$ 是标量字段的数量。然后，我们指出，通过利用真空能量的线性，可以将问题简化为比特串的两个块之间的碰撞问题。通过这种结构，我们构造了两个查询复杂度为 $\mathcal{O}(2^{N/3})$ 的量子算法。与 Denef 和 Douglas 的伪多项式经典算法相比，量子算法大大降低了物理驱动参数值的计算成本。

title: Soft-photon theorem near static spherical horizons in generic dimensions
abstract: We study Maxwell theory near a nonextremal bifurcate Killing horizon in a general static, spherically symmetric spacetime of dimension $D>3$. We impose near-horizon boundary conditions in a regular Eddington--Finkelstein chart that retain both radiative and Coulombic data, and construct the associated horizon phase space and large-$U(1)$ charge. At null infinity, the radiative falloff depends on the spacetime dimension and involves half-integer powers in odd $D$, whereas a nonextremal horizon at finite radius supports radiative data with an ordinary integer-power expansion. Expanding the horizon fields in Killing frequency and spherical harmonics, we derive the associated soft-photon relation from the large-$U(1)$ Ward identity. For comparison, we express the flat-space leading soft-photon theorem using the same spherical harmonics and commutator normalization as the horizon modes. In $D=4$, the two relations have the same soft-frequency dependence and the same angular dependence of the hard-charge terms, whereas for $D>4$ the flat-space relation contains additional dimension-dependent frequency and angular factors.
summary: 我们在维度 $D>3$ 的一般静态、球对称时空中研究非极值分叉杀视界附近的麦克斯韦理论。我们在保留辐射和库仑数据的常规爱丁顿-芬克尔斯坦图中施加近地平线边界条件，并构造相关的地平线相空间和大$U(1)$电荷。在零无穷大处，辐射衰减取决于时空维度，并涉及奇数 $D$ 中的半整数幂，而有限半径处的非极值地平线支持具有普通整数幂展开的辐射数据。扩展杀伤频率和球谐函数中的视界场，我们从大$U(1)$ Ward 恒等式中推导出相关的软光子关系。为了进行比较，我们使用与水平模式相同的球谐函数和换向器归一化来表达平坦空间领先的软光子定理。在 $D=4$ 中，这两个关系具有相同的软频率依赖性和相同的硬电荷项角度依赖性，而对于 $D>4$，平坦空间关系包含额外的与尺寸相关的频率和角度因子。

title: Spin-1 Bulk Local States in AdS/CFT and Carrollian Holography
abstract: We construct the bulk local states of a massive spin-1 field in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ and three-dimensional Carrollian holography. In AdS, covariance under the isometries that leave a bulk point invariant determines the three components of the vector there and splits the solution into two branches of definite helicity, whose inner products reproduce the massive vector two-point function of AdS$_3$. By expanding the massive vector HKLL representation in boundary descendants, one can reproduce the three component states term by term. The two branches together describe the parity-invariant Proca field, and one alone the single propagating mode of Maxwell--Chern--Simons theory. The same conditions are solved in the induced representation of the Carrollian theory, where the solution again splits into two branches. Under the flat limit of the generators the highest weight module becomes the induced module, and the AdS states and Green's functions become their Carrollian counterparts, which supports the induced representation as the home of massive bulk excitations in Carrollian holography. This is the first bulk local state built with spin, complete from the state itself to its bulk-to-bulk propagator and to the limit relating the two descriptions.
summary:
我们在 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 和三维卡罗尔全息术中构建了大规模自旋 1 场的大量局域态。在 AdS 中，留下大量点不变量的等距下的协方差决定了向量的三个分量，并将解分成两个具有确定螺旋性的分支，其内积再现了 AdS$_3$ 的大规模向量两点函数。通过扩展边界后代中的大规模向量 HKLL 表示，可以逐项重现三个分量状态。这两个分支共同描述了宇称不变的普罗卡场，其中一个分支单独描述了麦克斯韦-陈-西蒙斯理论的单一传播模式。在卡罗尔理论的诱导表示中解决了相同的条件，其中解决方案再次分为两个分支。在发生器的平坦极限下，最高权重模块成为感应模块，并且 AdS 状态和格林函数成为它们的卡罗尔对应物，这支持感应表示作为卡罗尔全息术中大量体激发的所在地。

这是第一个用自旋构建的批量本地状态，从状态本身到其批量传播器以及与两个描述相关的限制都是完整的。

title: Thermodynamics and mechanical laws of causal-diamond horizons
abstract: We develop a unified thermodynamic and mechanical framework for causal-diamond horizons in Minkowski spacetime. Euclidean regularity fixes the temperature $T_D=1/(\pi\alpha)$, where $2\alpha$ is the temporal extent of the diamond. The regulated Gibbons--Hawking--York contribution gives $I_D^E=-A_0/(4G)$, with $A_0$ the area of the horizon bifurcation surface, and the vanishing equilibrium geometric energy then yields the entropy--area relation $S_D=A_0/(4G)$. For weak matter perturbations crossing a localized portion of the future horizon, a Raychaudhuri analysis relates the associated Killing-energy flux to the area response, yielding a local physical-process first law at leading order near the bifurcation surface and, for classical matter satisfying the null energy condition, a local second law. Uniform conformal surface gravity establishes the zeroth law, while zero temperature is approached only in the limit $\alpha\to\infty$, in which the finite causal horizon disappears. These results show that a coherent horizon-law structure can arise within a causal diamond, a fundamental building block of the causal structure of Minkowski spacetime. The derivation is explicit in $(2+1)$ dimensions, while the physical results retain the same form for spherical causal diamonds in $d\geq3$.
summary:
我们为闵可夫斯基时空中的因果钻石视界开发了一个统一的热力学和力学框架。欧几里得正则确定了温度 $T_D=1/(\pi\alpha)$，其中 $2\alpha$ 是钻石的时间范围。调节后的 Gibbons--Hawking--York 贡献给出 $I_D^E=-A_0/(4G)$，其中 $A_0$ 是地平线分叉面的面积，消失的平衡几何能量则产生熵-面积关系 $S_D=A_0/(4G)$。对于跨越未来视界局部部分的弱物质扰动，Raychaudhuri 分析将相关的杀伤能量通量与区域响应联系起来，在分叉表面附近产生主序的局部物理过程第一定律，并且对于满足零能量条件的经典物质，产生局部第二定律。均匀共形表面重力建立了第零定律，而零温度仅在极限 $\alpha\to\infty$ 内接近，其中有限因果视界消失。这些结果表明，因果菱形内可以出现连贯的视界定律结构，因果菱形是闵可夫斯基时空因果结构的基本组成部分。

推导在 $(2+1)$ 维度中是明确的，而物理结果在 $d\geq3$ 中保留了与球形因果钻石相同的形式。

title: Spontaneous Hawking Radiation from Dynamical Black-Hole Formation in Quantum Spin Systems
abstract: We show that Hawking radiation spontaneously generated by dynamical black-hole formation can be realized in a local quantum spin model. Starting from the ground state corresponding to the early-time vacuum, with no initially prepared excitations, we follow the dynamics induced by the evolving geometry. In the corresponding continuum quantum field theory, Hawking particle creation is associated with nontrivial Bogoliubov mixing between the in- and out-mode decompositions. We derive the resulting renormalized local energy density in the continuum quantum field theory, which corresponds to an energy-weighted integral of the Hawking spectrum, and identify its counterpart as a local spin observable whose expectation value quantitatively reproduces the continuum prediction, including its dependence on the surface gravity. The agreement persists over a finite time window whose duration grows logarithmically with system size, revealing the crossover from universal continuum Hawking physics to lattice-cutoff dynamics. These results establish a microscopic route to quantum simulation of quantum field theory in curved spacetime, connecting field-theoretic particle creation directly to experimentally accessible many-body observables.
summary:
我们证明，动态黑洞形成自发产生的霍金辐射可以在局域量子自旋模型中实现。从对应于早期真空的基态开始，在没有最初准备的激发的情况下，我们遵循由不断演化的几何形状引起的动力学。在相应的连续量子场论中，霍金粒子的产生与入模分解和出模分解之间的非平凡博戈柳博夫混合有关。我们推导了连续量子场论中所得到的重整化局部能量密度，它对应于霍金谱的能量加权积分，并将其对应物识别为局部自旋可观测量，其期望值定量地再现了连续统预测，包括其对表面重力的依赖性。该协议在有限的时间窗口内持续存在，其持续时间随系统尺寸呈对数增长，揭示了从通用连续体霍金物理学到晶格截止动力学的交叉。

这些结果为弯曲时空中量子场论的量子模拟建立了一条微观途径，将场论粒子的产生直接与实验上可访问的多体可观测值联系起来。

title: Reheating surface volume renormalization and eternal inflation under broken scale invariance
abstract: Recently, Cotler, Ivo, and Maldacena have shown that under scale invariance, eternal inflation is interpreted as a failure of the reheating surface volume renormalization due to an ill-defined scaling dimension. Meanwhile, observations suggest that scale invariance is slightly broken, which is parametrized by deviation of the spectral index from unity, $\varepsilon=n_s-1$. Motivated by this, we study how the scale invariance breaking effect modifies the no-eternal inflation condition as the renormalizability of the reheating surface volume. For this purpose, we adopt two independent approaches: investigating the behavior of the normal ordered reheating surface volume operator under a shift of the curvature perturbation, and analyzing the coarse-graining structure to obtain the scaling dimension. Both approaches commonly reveal that as long as $\varepsilon$ is negative, which is consistent with observations, the fractal structure of the reheating surface volume breaks down at macroscopic scale, moderating the no-eternal inflation condition.
summary: 最近，Cotler、Ivo 和 Maldacena 表明，在尺度不变性下，永恒膨胀被解释为由于尺度尺寸定义不明确而导致的再加热表面体积重整化的失败。同时，观察表明尺度不变性被稍微打破，这是通过光谱指数与统一的偏差$\varepsilon=n_s-1$来参数化的。受此启发，我们研究了尺度不变性破坏效应如何将非永恒膨胀条件修改为再加热表面体积的可重正化性。为此，我们采用两种独立的方法：研究正常有序再热表面体积算子在曲率摄动下的行为，并分析粗粒结构以获得缩放维数。两种方法通常都表明，只要 $\varepsilon$ 为负（这与观测结果一致），再加热表面体积的分形结构就会在宏观尺度上崩溃，从而缓和非永恒膨胀条件。

title: On connection between associators and 6j-symbols
abstract: We propose a new formula relating the rationalized Drinfeld associators obtained from the Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov equation to the quantum $6j$-symbols of the algebra $\mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{g})$: $ U_{q} = U \cdot \Phi^{KZ}_{\mathbb{Q}} $. We prove this relation in the case of the $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ Lie algebra for the tensor cube of the fundamental and the first symmetric representation. We also check it perturbatively for the $\mathfrak{sl}_N$ algebra for representations $[2]\otimes [1] \otimes [1]$, $[2]\otimes [2] \otimes [1]$, the non-trivial cases with multiplicities --- $[2,1]^{\otimes 3}$, $[2,2]^{\otimes 3}$, and in the case of the $\mathfrak{so}_5$ Lie algebra for the tensor cube of the fundamental representation.
summary: 我们提出了一个新公式，将从 Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov 方程获得的有理化 Drinfeld 关联子与代数 $\mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{g})$ 的量子 $6j$ 符号相关联：$ U_{q} = U \cdot \Phi^{KZ}_{\mathbb{Q}} $。我们在基本和第一个对称表示的张量立方的 $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ 李代数的情况下证明了这种关系。我们还对 $\mathfrak{sl}_N$ 代数进行扰动检查，以表示 $[2]\otimes [1] \otimes [1]$、$[2]\otimes [2] \otimes [1]$，具有多重性的非平凡情况 --- $[2,1]^{\otimes 3}$、$[2,2]^{\otimes 3}$，以及在 $\mathfrak{so}_5$ 的情况下，基本表示的张量立方体的李代数。

title: Conformal Anomalies and Generalised Energy Conservation in De Sitter Spacetime
abstract: We show that for bulk discrete series fields whose dual operators have integer conformal dimensions, the Generalised Energy Conservation (GEC) condition for de Sitter (dS) scattering amplitudes defined in even-dimensional extended Poincaré spacetime corresponds precisely to the absence of boundary conformal anomalies, including beta-function contributions, at the level of tree-level contact interactions. In contrast, holographic consistency in AdS/CFT enforces only the locality of the conformal anomaly. We find novel, unique four-point interactions involving three identical conformally coupled scalars and one discrete series scalar by performing both GEC and holographic bootstraps. This demonstrates that the solutions to GEC form a measure-zero subset of the holographically consistent solutions. Our holographic analysis agrees precisely with the expected renormalisation conditions for conformal field theory correlators. In addition, the constraint for a particular four-point configuration may be relevant for testing holographic consistency of scale-separated non-supersymmetric AdS$_4$ vacua.
summary: 我们证明，对于双算子具有整数共形维数的体离散系列场，偶维扩展庞加莱时空中定义的德西特（dS）散射振幅的广义能量守恒（GEC）条件精确地对应于在树级接触相互作用层面不存在边界共形异常，包括β函数贡献。相比之下，AdS/CFT 中的全息一致性仅强制保形异常的局部性。通过执行 GEC 和全息自举，我们发现了新颖、独特的四点相互作用，涉及三个相同的共形耦合标量和一个离散级数标量。这表明 GEC 的解形成了全息一致解的零测度子集。我们的全息分析与共形场论相关器的预期重整化条件完全一致。此外，特定四点配置的约束可能与测试尺度分离的非超对称 AdS$_4$ 真空的全息一致性相关。

title: What a knot sees at a root of unity
abstract: HOMFLY-PT polynomials describe analytic continuation of Wilson averages in Chern-Simons theory to arbitrary complex values of two independent parameters $q$ and $A$. They also depend on the knot and representation of the gauge group. However, when $q^2$ is a primitive $m$-th root of unity, e.g. $q=\pm e^{i\pi/m}$, these polynomials exhibit a universal (knot-independent) factorization: $H_R$ becomes the product of the polynomials for the $m$-core of the Young diagram $R$ and of one and the same factor $H_{[m]}$ for every $m$-ribbon of $R$. In all the examples which we computed this factor is just the special polynomial at $A^m$. At $q=\pm1$ factorization follows from the singularity of the cabled HOMFLY, which is the same for all representations. At $m>1$ the relevant singularity is in the projector, and what survives of it is a finite sum of braids $X_m$ -- the $m$-th power sum inside the cable, which can be freely moved through the other strands. For the proof we use the Murnaghan-Nakayama rule and the Adams operation. Discovery of this hidden structure explains the old factorization puzzle.
summary: HOMFLY-PT 多项式描述 Chern-Simons 理论中的 Wilson 平均值对两个独立参数 $q$ 和 $A$ 的任意复数值的解析延拓。它们还取决于规格组的结和表示。然而，当 $q^2$ 是原初 $m$ 单位根时，例如$q=\pm e^{i\pi/m}$，这些多项式表现出通用（与结无关）因式分解：$H_R$ 成为杨氏图 $R$ 的 $m$-核心的多项式与 $R$ 的每个 $m$-ribbon 的一个且相同的因子 $H_{[m]}$ 的乘积。在我们计算的所有示例中，该因子只是 $A^m$ 处的特殊多项式。在 $q=\pm1$ 处，分解遵循有线 HOMFLY 的奇点，这对于所有表示形式都是相同的。在 $m>1$ 处，相关奇点位于投影仪中，而它留下的是辫子 $X_m$ 的有限总和——电缆内部的 $m$ 次幂和，可以通过其他股线自由移动。为了证明，我们使用 Murnaghan-Nakayama 规则和 Adams 运算。这种隐藏结构的发现解释了古老的因式分解难题。

title: Segre determinants and MHV gravity amplitudes
abstract: We describe a Segre-Veronese construction of polynomial solutions to the interpolation conditions of the numerators of tree-level MHV gravity amplitudes given by Hodges' formula. The five- and six-point Hodges numerators arise from Segre determinants, while for every $n\geq7$ suitable Segre determinants lead to solutions linearly independent of the Hodges numerator. The existence of such independent elements for $n=7,8$ was recently established by Mai and Zhang.
summary: 我们描述了由 Hodges 公式给出的树级 MHV 重力振幅分子插值条件的多项式解的 Segre-Veronese 构造。五点和六点 Hodges 分子由 Segre 行列式产生，而对于每个 $n\geq7$ 合适的 Segre 行列式会导致线性独立于 Hodges 分子的解。 Mai 和Zhang 最近证实$n=7,8$ 存在这种独立元素。

title: Relative-Entropy Flow Across the Page Transition
abstract: We develop a computational framework for the quantum relative entropy based on the replica trick and apply it to analyze the evaporation process method of Jackiw-Teitelboim black holes. We show that the relative entropies between the exact radiation state and the Hawking saddle state and the replica wormholes saddle state quantify information-theoretic costs inherent to coarse-grained semiclassical descriptions. During evaporation, the relative entropy for the Hawking saddle increases monotonically, reflecting a progressively higher thermodynamic cost of sustaining the Hawking description. Conversely, the relative entropy associated with the replica wormholes saddle decreases, which indicates that the description of connected geometries becomes progressively more accurate. Moreover, the sign of the difference between the two quantities reverses precisely at the Page time, providing an information-theoretic diagnosis for the transition between competing gravitational saddles. Our results recast the Page transition as a flow of relative entropy costs between competing semi-classical descriptions, revealing an information-theoretic structure underlying the emergence of effective irreversibility in coarse-grained black hole evaporation.
summary:
我们开发了一个基于复制技巧的量子相对熵计算框架，并将其应用于分析Jackiw-Teitelboim黑洞的蒸发过程方法。我们证明，精确辐射态与霍金鞍态和复制虫洞鞍态之间的相对熵量化了粗粒度半经典描述固有的信息论成本。在蒸发过程中，霍金鞍的相对熵单调增加，反映出维持霍金描述的热力学成本逐渐升高。相反，与复制虫洞鞍相关的相对熵减少，这表明对相连几何形状的描述变得越来越准确。此外，两个量之间的差异的符号在页面时间精确反转，为竞争引力鞍之间的转变提供了信息论诊断。

我们的结果将页面转变重新描述为竞争的半经典描述之间的相对熵成本流，揭示了粗粒黑洞蒸发中有效不可逆性出现的信息论结构。

title: Gauge-covariant Hadamard descent in Yang-Mills theory
abstract: We study the dimensional reduction of non-Abelian Yang-Mills theory from five to four dimensions. In this framework, Hadamard descent is formulated as a restriction to gauge-equivalence classes that are invariant, up to gauge transformations, under translations along the reduced direction. The central result is that, prior to gauge fixing, the adjoint scalar of the reduced theory is not the connection component $A_u$ itself, but the gauge-covariant combination $\widetilde{\Phi}=\epsilon-\iota_YA$, which follows naturally from the covariant Cartan identity. The usual identification with $A_u$ is recovered, up to the sign convention adopted here, in the $u$-independent gauge, while global holonomy data remain additional information to be specified separately. We show that the reduced theory takes the form of a Yang--Mills--Higgs theory with the Higgs field in the adjoint representation. As an example, we focus on the $U(2)$ gauge theory and analyze the Higgs mechanism, together with the associated symmetry breaking pattern, when the reduced theory is expanded around the ground state of the parent theory. We then include fermions and show that, in the $u$-independent gauge, the extra-dimensional component of the gauge connection generates a pseudoscalar Yukawa coupling which, on the vacuum configuration, can be converted into a fermion mass term by a chiral field redefinition, while the gauge interaction remains vectorial.
summary:
我们研究非阿贝尔杨米尔斯理论从五维到四维的降维。在此框架中，哈达玛下降被表述为对规范等价类的限制，这些规范等价类在沿缩减方向的平移下在规范变换下保持不变。核心结果是，在规范固定之前，简化理论的伴随标量不是连接分量 $A_u$ 本身，而是规范协变组合 $\widetilde{\Phi}=\epsilon-\iota_YA$，它自然地从协变嘉当恒等式得出。在与 $u$ 无关的量规中，按照此处采用的符号约定，恢复了与 $A_u$ 的通常标识，而全局完整数据仍保留需要单独指定的附加信息。我们证明简化理论采用杨-米尔斯-希格斯理论的形式，希格斯场作为伴随表示。例如，当简化理论围绕母理论的基态展开时，我们重点关注 $U(2)$ 规范理论并分析希格斯机制以及相关的对称性破缺模式。

然后，我们将费米子包括在内，并表明，在与 $u$ 无关的规范中，规范连接的超维分量会生成赝标量汤川耦合，在真空配置上，可以通过手性场重新定义将其转换为费米子质量项，而规范相互作用保持矢量。

title: Glueball gravitational form factors in dynamical holography
abstract: We present the first holographic study of gravitational form factors (GFFs) of scalar, pseudoscalar and canonical-spin-averaged tensor glueball targets. These observables test gravitational cubic couplings whose physical validity is not established by spectra and static-force calibration. We construct a dynamical Einstein--scalar--axion representation inspired by the Babington--Crooks--Evans adjoint-mass deformation of $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory and its Type-IIB supergravity dual. Leading ultraviolet source data are retained, while a soft-wall-like infrared reconstruction incorporates asymptotically linear radial mass-squared trajectories. Spectra and Wilson observables fix the parameters at a common Sommer scale without GFF input. The full constrained cubic vertices fail to describe 27 correlated scalar lattice observations, giving $\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}=73.60/27=2.73$. We propose normalized heavy-target (HT) effective cubic couplings for pure-glue matching. HT adopts leading radial shapes suggested by infinitely heavy targets at fixed probe dynamics and normalizes their overlap weights on the physical ground states. With the background, modes and propagators unchanged, HT gives $\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}=16.98/27=0.63$, without numerical adjustment to GFF data. Tensor and scalar source overlaps determine $A$ and the physical normalized trace; the exact finite-mass energy--momentum-tensor relation determines $D$. We predict the pseudoscalar and tensor form factors and three-target Breit pressure and shear profiles. On the reference infrared-decaying axion branch, the HT Breit mass radii are $0.276$, $0.300$ and $0.311\,\mathrm{fm}$, respectively. The results identify gravitational cubic matching as a distinct step beyond background calibration and provide a prescription for further lattice tests.
summary:
我们首次对标量、伪标量和正则自旋平均张量胶球目标的引力形状因子（GFF）进行全息研究。这些可观测量测试了引力立方耦合，其物理有效性不是通过光谱和静力校准来确定的。我们构造了一个动态的爱因斯坦标量轴子表示，其灵感来自$\mathcal N=4$超杨-米尔斯理论及其IIB型超引力对偶的巴宾顿-克鲁克斯-埃文斯伴随质量变形。保留了主要的紫外源数据，而软壁状红外重建则包含了渐近线性径向质量平方轨迹。 Spectra 和 Wilson 可观测量将参数固定在通用 Sommer 尺度上，无需 GFF 输入。完整约束立方顶点无法描述 27 个相关标量晶格观测值，给出 $\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}=73.60/27=2.73$。我们提出了用于纯胶匹配的归一化重目标（HT）有效立方耦合。 HT 采用固定探针动力学下无限重目标所建议的领先径向形状，并在物理基态上标准化它们的重叠权重。

在背景、模式和传播器不变的情况下，HT 给出 $\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}=16.98/27=0.63$，无需对 GFF 数据进行数值调整。张量和标量源重叠确定 $A$ 和物理归一化迹线；精确的有限质量能量-动量-张量关系决定了$D$。我们预测赝标量和张量形状因子以及三目标 Breit 压力和剪切剖面。在参考红外衰变轴子分支上，HT Breit 质量半径分别为 $0.276$、$0.300$ 和 $0.311\,\mathrm{fm}$。结果表明，引力立方匹配是超越背景校准的一个独特步骤，并为进一步的晶格测试提供了处方。

title: Projected Yang-Mills Theory and the MacDowell-Mansouri Analogy
abstract: We study $SO(2n)$ gauge theories with a degenerate curvature kinetic operator defined by an orthogonal complex structure. The kinetic image is $\su(n)$, while the adjoint vacuum has stabilizer $U(n)$. We distinguish fixed projectors, unrestricted adjoint Higgs fields, and Higgs fields constrained exactly to the orbit $SO(2n)/U(n)$. For the constrained theory with a positive Higgs kinetic coefficient, the coset connection is auxiliary and the central connection is null. A nonlinear Dirac analysis establishes a regular weak-curvature branch with $2(n^2-1)$ physical degrees of freedom in four dimensions, locally equivalent to $SU(n)$ Yang--Mills theory. Normal Higgs displacements in the unrestricted theory can change the kinetic rank, so this count does not extend to that field space. We also characterize possible algebraic branches. We express the Stelle--West Higgs--gravity action through a common Clifford involution, and introduce projected Pontryagin theories and a full-rank equivariant completion.
summary: 我们使用由正交复数结构定义的简并曲率动力学算子来研究 $SO(2n)$ 规范理论。动力学图像为$\su(n)$，而伴随真空具有稳定器$U(n)$。我们区分固定投影仪、不受限制的伴随希格斯场和严格限制在轨道 $SO(2n)/U(n)$ 的希格斯场。对于希格斯动力学系数为正的约束理论，陪集连接是辅助的，中心连接是空的。非线性狄拉克分析建立了一个规则的弱曲率分支，在四个维度上具有 $2(n^2-1)$ 物理自由度，局部等效于 $SU(n)$ Yang--Mills 理论。无限制理论中的正常希格斯位移可以改变动力学等级，因此该计数不会扩展到该场空间。我们还描述了可能的代数分支。我们通过共同的克利福德对合来表达斯特尔（West Higgs）引力作用，并引入投影庞特里亚金理论和满秩等变完成。

title: Connected Geometries in Gravitational Path Integrals, and Normalized No-Boundary Probabilities
abstract: We argue that some of the puzzling features associated with the normalization of gravitational wave functions can be substantially alleviated by restricting the path integral to a sum over connected, allowable geometries. This prescription gives sensible results when applied to classical transitions and it provides non-trivial no-boundary probabilities, in line with old expectations. We highlight the additional impact of both boundary conditions and integration contours on these issues.
summary: 我们认为，通过将路径积分限制为连接的、允许的几何形状上的总和，可以大大缓解与引力波函数标准化相关的一些令人费解的特征。当应用于经典转移时，这个处方给出了合理的结果，并且它提供了不平凡的无边界概率，与旧的期望一致。我们强调边界条件和积分轮廓对这些问题的额外影响。

title: Light bending at two-loop order from scattering amplitudes
abstract: We calculate the conservative deflection of a photon by a massive spinless source, such as a black hole, at third post-Minkowskian order using scattering amplitudes. We work in the heavy-source and long-range limits and adopt the geometric-optics approximation. The required five-point photon-graviton tree amplitude is constructed by on-shell recursion and sewn to three scalar-graviton vertices across a five-fold cut. Polynomial division organizes the cut information into sixteen contributions, including the residues with fewer propagators. We perform the source energy integrations and retain the near-on-shell photon regions in the remaining spatial integrals. Within the static region in which all exchanged momenta are soft, we relate a photon pole prescription to the subtraction of the cubic tree iteration from the conservative kernel. The sum of the sixteen contributions determines the classical logarithmic term at two loops. Its transverse Fourier transform gives the interaction radial action and yields the third-order deflection angle. The result agrees with the weak-deflection expansion of Schwarzschild null geodesics and demonstrates how nonlinear classical light bending is encoded in loop amplitudes around flat spacetime.
summary:
我们使用散射振幅计算后闵可夫斯基第三阶的巨大无自旋源（例如黑洞）对光子的保守偏转。我们在重源和远距离限制下工作，并采用几何光学近似。所需的五点光子引力子树振幅是通过壳内递归构建的，并缝合到跨五折切口的三个标量引力子顶点。多项式除法将切割信息组织为十六个贡献，包括具有较少传播者的残数。我们执行源能量积分并在剩余的空间积分中保留近壳光子区域。在所有交换动量都是软的静态区域内，我们将光子极规定与从保守核中减去立方树迭代相关联。十六个贡献的总和确定了两个循环处的经典对数项。其横向傅里叶变换给出了相互作用的径向作用并产生三阶偏转角。

结果与史瓦西零测地线的弱偏转展开一致，并演示了非线性经典光弯曲如何编码在平坦时空周围的环振幅中。

title: QCD_2: 't Hooft equation vs. relativistic Schroedinger equation
abstract: We discuss 2-dimensional $QCD$ with a fundamental quark of mass $m$ in the 't Hooft limit ($N \to \infty, \, g^2 \to 0, \, g^2N =$ const). The spectrum of this theory includes a chain of meson states. The masses of these states can be evaluated by solving the proper integral Bethe-Salpeter equation. An alternative simple procedure consists in solving the Schrödinger equation for the relativistic Hamiltonian $$ \hat H\ =\ 2\sqrt{\hat p^2 + m^2} + \sigma |x| $$ with the string tension $\sigma = g^2N/4$. We compare the results obtained by these two methods. In the leading semiclassical approximation, they coincide. We show, however, that the preasymptotic WKB corrections to the masses calculated in these two ways are different. For the ground state, they play an essential role. But already for $n=3$, the relative difference between the two predictions does not exceed 2.5\% and rapidly falls off as $n$ increases.
summary: 我们讨论 't Hooft 极限内质量为 $m$ 的基本夸克的二维 $QCD$ ($N \to \infty, \, g^2 \to 0, \, g^2N =$ const)。该理论的范围包括介子态链。这些状态的质量可以通过求解真积分 Bethe-Salpeter 方程来评估。另一种简单的程序是求解相对论哈密顿量的薛定谔方程 $$ \hat H\ =\ 2\sqrt{\hat p^2 + m^2} + \sigma |x| $$ 弦张力 $\sigma = g^2N/4$。我们比较这两种方法获得的结果。在领先的半经典近似中，它们是一致的。然而，我们表明，用这两种方法计算的质量的渐近 WKB 修正是不同的。对于基态来说，它们起着至关重要的作用。但对于 $n=3$，两个预测之间的相对差异不超过 2.5%，并且随着 $n$ 的增加而迅速下降。

title: Inverse construction of exact atmospheric models and the 3.7--4.4\,mHz acoustic resonances
abstract: Large explosive eruptions and earthquakes excite atmospheric oscillations near 3.7 and 4.4\,mHz that couple to the solid Earth. For vertically propagating linear acoustic--gravity waves in a hydrostatic ideal-gas atmosphere, the travel-time formulation gives a Klein--Gordon equation with a potential $Q(\tau)$. We establish three main results. First, for every potential admitting a positive zero-energy solution, the corresponding atmospheric profiles are constructed explicitly by quadrature; this extends the known reflectionless profiles of constant $Q$. Second, Darboux--Crum potentials give a smooth atmosphere that reproduces the U.S. Standard Atmosphere between 11 and 100\,km to within 3\,K and is exactly transparent to vertical waves above its cut-off; it supports no damped overtone near 4.4\,mHz, and its ground-confined mode below the cut-off is perfectly trapped. The observed spectrum therefore requires a cut-off barrier of finite thickness connecting the lower atmosphere to the thermosphere. Third, a Rosen--Morse barrier gives an exactly solvable atmosphere with a closed-form hypergeometric resonance condition. Its resonances at 3.76 and 4.37\,mHz, with leakage quality factors 173 and 20, explain the different damping of the two oscillations: the fundamental lies below the top of the mesospheric cut-off barrier and leaks by tunnelling, whereas the overtone lies above it. Full-wave computations for event-specific atmospheres reproduce the reported 3.7--3.8\,mHz fundamental oscillation in all six events, of seven considered, in which such a mode was identified.
summary:
大型爆炸性喷发和地震会激发 3.7 和 4.4 mHz 附近的大气振荡，并与固体地球耦合。对于在静压理想气体气氛中垂直传播的线性声重力波，走时公式给出了具有势 $Q(\tau)$ 的 Klein-Gordon 方程。我们得出三个主要结果。首先，对于每个允许正零能量解的势，通过求积显式地构造相应的大气剖面；这扩展了已知的常数$Q$的无反射轮廓。其次，Darboux-Crum 势能提供平滑的大气层，可在 11 至 100\,km 之间再现美国标准大气，误差范围在 3\,K 范围内，并且对于其截止点以上的垂直波完全透明；它不支持 4.4\,mHz 附近的阻尼泛音，并且其截止频率以下的地面限制模式被完美捕获。因此，观测到的光谱需要一个有限厚度的截止屏障，将低层大气与热层连接起来。第三，罗森-莫尔斯势垒给出了具有封闭形式超几何共振条件的精确可解大气。

它在 3.76 和 4.37 mHz 处的谐振，泄漏品质因数为 173 和 20，解释了两种振荡的不同阻尼：基频位于中层截止屏障顶部下方，并通过隧道泄漏，而泛音位于其上方。针对特定事件大气的全波计算再现了所有六个事件中报告的 3.7--3.8\,mHz 基本振荡，其中考虑了七个事件，其中确定了这种模式。

title: Araki Cohomology of the de Sitter Scalar Discrete Series
abstract: Building on the recently established de Sitter (dS)-covariant indecomposable Krein realization of the scalar discrete-series unitary irreducible representations $\Pi_{p,0}$, $p=1,2,\cdots$, of $\mathrm{SO}_0(1,4)$, naturally organized into a Gupta-Bleuler triplet, we uncover its underlying Araki-cohomological structure. We show that the Krein-Gupta-Bleuler construction provides a concrete realization of Araki's standard Gupta-Bleuler triplet, with its non-split indecomposable structure encoded by non-trivial first cohomology classes related by adjunction. We further show that the reducible intermediate sector naturally resolves into its two irreducible components, inducing a corresponding decomposition of the extension classes and yielding a four-layer refinement of Araki's standard triplet. The resulting Gupta-Bleuler quadruplet provides a finer cohomological resolution, distinguishing the physical representation from its complex-conjugate sector.
summary: 基于最近建立的 de Sitter (dS) 协变不可分解 Kerin 实现标量离散级数酉表示 $\Pi_{p,0}$、$p=1,2,\cdots$ 和 $\mathrm{SO}_0(1,4)$，自然地组织成 Gupta-Bleuler 三元组，我们揭示了其底层的 Araki 上同调结构。我们证明，Krein-Gupta-Bleuler 构造提供了 Araki 标准 Gupta-Bleuler 三元组的具体实现，其不可分割的不可分解结构由通过附加相关的非平凡第一上同调类编码。我们进一步表明，可约中间部分自然地分解为其两个不可约组件，从而引起扩展类的相应分解并产生荒木标准三元组的四层细化。由此产生的古普塔-布勒勒四联体提供了更精细的上同调分辨率，将物理表示与其复共轭扇区区分开来。

title: Conformal invariance of the six-vertex model's height function
abstract: In this paper, we show that the height function of the six-vertex model in simply connected domains with piecewise constant boundary conditions converges to the Gaussian Free Field (GFF) with Dirichlet boundary conditions. This implies the conformal invariance of the scaling limit of the model. The argument relies on the full plane GFF convergence combined with Reflexion Positivity and qualitative estimates. The proof works for a wide range of spectral parameters $\Delta$ (among which $\Delta$ close to $0$, and between $-1$ and $-1/2$) making this paper the first instance of a conformal invariance result for a continuum of models. The paper has consequences for other models, including the FK percolation with cluster-weight $q=4$ and the Ashkin-Teller model, which we will pursue in future work.
summary: 在本文中，我们证明了具有分段常数边界条件的简单连通域中六顶点模型的高度函数收敛到具有狄利克雷边界条件的高斯自由场（GFF）。这意味着模型缩放极限的共形不变性。该论证依赖于全平面 GFF 收敛以及反射正性和定性估计。该证明适用于广泛的谱参数 $\Delta$（其中 $\Delta$ 接近 $0$，并且在 $-1$ 和 $-1/2$ 之间），使本文成为模型连续体的共形不变性结果的第一个实例。这篇论文对其他模型产生了影响，包括簇权重 $q=4$ 的 FK 渗透和 Ashkin-Teller 模型，我们将在未来的工作中继续研究。

title: Spontaneous symmetry breaking at any temperature in a local one-dimensional model
abstract: We present a one-dimensional classical statistical physics model on an infinite lattice with nearest-neighbor interactions and local state space $\mathbb{Z}^2$, with a ``helical" symmetry group $\mathbb{Z}^2\rtimes \mathbb{Z}$ mixing flavor symmetry with spatial translation. For any $0<\beta<\infty$, we construct an uncountable infinity of DLR (Gibbs) states parameterized by $\mathbb{R}^2$, with a free $\mathbb{Z}^2$ flavor symmetry group action; as such, we interpret the model as exhibiting spontaneous symmetry breaking at any temperature. The most general DLR state we construct is interpreted as an infinite sequence of localized domain walls separating a pair of asymptotic ``symmetry sectors". Although any normalizable Gibbs state necessarily breaks a countably infinite freely-acting symmetry group, a natural regularization of the problem to (arbitrarily) large but finite systems with periodic boundary conditions has measure concentration in disjoint and far-separated symmetry-related clusters in the (now unique) Gibbs state, which justifies our interpretation of spontaneous symmetry breaking on the infinite line. A modification of the model with local state space $\mathbb{R}^2$ must break a continuous helical symmetry at any temperature. This is not a contradiction with the Mermin-Wagner Theorem, because this continuous helical symmetry is non-compact and does not commute with translation.
summary:
我们在具有最近邻相互作用和局部状态空间 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 的无限格子上提出了一个一维经典统计物理模型，具有“螺旋”对称群 $\mathbb{Z}^2\rtimes \mathbb{Z}$ 将风味对称性与空间平移混合。对于任何 $0<\beta<\infty$，我们构造了不可数无穷的 DLR (Gibbs) 状态，参数化为： $\mathbb{R}^2$，具有自由的 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 风味对称群作用；因此，我们将模型解释为在任何温度下表现出自发对称破缺，我们构建的最一般的 DLR 状态被解释为分隔一对渐近“对称扇区”的局部域壁的无限序列。尽管任何可归一化的吉布斯状态必然会破坏可数无限的自由作用对称群，但将问题自然正则化为具有周期性边界条件的（任意）大但有限的系统，可以测量（现在唯一的）吉布斯状态中不相交且相距较远的对称相关簇的集中度，这证明了我们对无限线上自发对称破缺的解释是合理的。

使用局部状态空间 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 修改模型必须打破任何温度下的连续螺旋对称性。这与 Mermin-Wagner 定理并不矛盾，因为这种连续螺旋对称性是非紧的，并且不与平移交换。

title: A mathematical analogy between certain hollow vortex and bubble flows - existence, uniqueness, and identical boundary shapes
abstract: We study two physically distinct steady free-boundary problems in a two-dimensional inviscid fluid: a hollow vortex in a constant-vorticity flow subject to simple shear, third order and linear strain at infinity, without surface tension, and an irrotational flow past a constant-pressure bubble subject to surface tension, linear strain, and circulation at infinity. Building on the mathematical vortex-bubble correspondence recently developed by Crowdy and Tanveer, we show that both problems are linked by a common mathematical formulation. For the vortex problem, we extend the sequence-space fixed-point approach of Crowdy and Tanveer to obtain new local existence, uniqueness, and analyticity results. For the bubble problem, we develop a separate existence theory, reducing it to a nonlinear singular integral operator fixed-point problem and deriving a scalar solvability condition that defines a realanalytic surface in the physical parameter space. On this surface we obtain locally unique bubble solutions with real-analytic boundaries and holomorphically extendible velocity fields. Finally, we prove that the scalar solvability condition is equivalent to a functional conformal mapping identity. The scalar condition between the parameters is enough for the vortex and bubble problems to have the same free-boundary shape, despite their different exterior flows.
summary:
我们研究了二维无粘流体中两个物理上不同的稳定自由边界问题：恒涡流中的空心涡流，受到简单剪切、三阶和无限远线性应变，没有表面张力，以及经过恒压气泡的无旋流，受到表面张力、线性应变和无穷远循环。基于克劳迪和坦维尔最近开发的数学涡泡对应关系，我们证明这两个问题都通过一个共同的数学公式联系起来。对于涡问题，我们扩展了 Crowdy 和 Tanveer 的序列空间定点方法，以获得新的局部存在性、唯一性和解析性结果。对于气泡问题，我们开发了一个单独的存在理论，将其简化为非线性奇异积分算子定点问题，并导出了定义物理参数空间中的实解析表面的标量可解性条件。在这个表面上，我们获得具有实解析边界和全纯可扩展速度场的局部唯一的气泡解。

最后，我们证明标量可解性条件等价于函数共形映射恒等式。参数之间的标量条件足以使涡流和气泡问题具有相同的自由边界形状，尽管它们的外部流动不同。

title: Pulsation of quantum walk on finite graph
abstract: We study discrete-time quantum walks on weighted graphs, where every edge in an edge cut set is assigned a small weight $\epsilon>0$. The parameter $\epsilon$ represents the strength of the connections through the cut edges: as $\epsilon \to 0$, these connections vanish, and the graph decomposes into the connected components obtained by removing the cut edges. We refer to these weighted cut edges as {\it weak edges}. We show that, for sufficiently small $\epsilon$ and on the time scale $t=\Theta(\epsilon^{-1/2})$, the finding probabilities between the connected components are asymptotically described by a continuous-time wave equation on a reduced graph, whose vertices represent the connected components and whose edges represent the weak edges connecting them. The wave equation is governed by a symmetric weighted Laplacian determined by the reduced graph and the number of arcs contained in the components. Consequently, finding probabilities of leading-term are independent of the detailed internal structures of the components. We further show that this wave equation has the same form as Newton's equation of motion for a classical spring-mass system on the reduced graph.
summary: 我们研究加权图上的离散时间量子行走，其中边切割集中的每条边都被分配一个小的权重 $\epsilon>0$。参数 $\epsilon$ 表示通过切边的连接强度：当 $\epsilon \to 0$ 时，这些连接消失，并且图分解为通过移除切边获得的连通分量。我们将这些加权切割边称为{\it 弱边}。我们证明，对于足够小的 $\epsilon$ 和时间尺度 $t=\Theta(\epsilon^{-1/2})$，连通分量之间的查找概率由简化图上的连续时间波动方程渐近描述，其顶点表示连通分量，其边表示连接它们的弱边。波动方程由对称加权拉普拉斯算子控制，该拉普拉斯算子由简化图和分量中包含的弧数确定。因此，找到首项的概率与组件的详细内部结构无关。我们进一步表明，该波动方程与简化图上经典弹簧质量系统的牛顿运动方程具有相同的形式。

title: Convergence Without Finite Exactness in the Eigenstate Quantum Bootstrap
abstract: The eigenstate quantum-mechanical bootstrap can converge to the physical moment set while remaining nonexact at every finite order. We prove this for a one-dimensional quasi-exactly solvable sextic oscillator at explicitly known eigenvalues, including excited levels. At every finite order, the lower and upper bounds on $u^2$ remain strictly below and above its physical value, even after adjoining arbitrary finite polynomial Gram tests and all eigenstate-annihilator relations visible in the retained moment space. Hence neither side of the centered observable admits a finite sum-of-squares certificate modulo the eigenstate annihilator. The gap persists under any finite set of additional localizing constraints whose weights are strictly positive on polynomial vectors. We then prove convergence for polynomial Schrödinger operators satisfying explicit sum-of-squares confinement and derivative bounds. The eigenstate relations give moment estimates uniform in the truncation order; these yield a regular Schrödinger representation supported on the prescribed eigenspace. Finally, a four-mode extension combines this fixed-observable obstruction with feasible position moments having no positive representing measure at every finite order. At level three, this construction yields nonphysical feasible points with strictly positive definite moment matrices.
summary:
本征态量子力学自举可以收敛到物理矩集，同时在每个有限阶上保持不精确。我们在明确已知特征值（包括激发能级）的一维准精确可解六次振子中证明了这一点。在每个有限阶，$u^2$ 的下限和上限仍然严格低于和高于其物理值，即使在相邻的任意有限多项式 Gram 测试和保留矩空间中可见的所有本征态-歼灭子关系之后也是如此。因此，中心可观测量的两侧都不承认以本征态歼灭子为模的有限平方和证明。在任何有限的附加局部化约束条件下，其权重在多项式向量上严格为正，这种差距仍然存在。然后，我们证明多项式薛定谔算子的收敛性满足显式平方和限制和导数界限。本征态关系给出截断顺序中均匀的矩估计；这些产生在规定的特征空间上支持的常规薛定谔表示。

最后，四模式扩展将这种固定可观察障碍物与可行位置力矩结合起来，在每个有限阶上没有正表示测量。在第三级，这种构造产生具有严格正定矩矩阵的非物理可行点。

title: Localization Dichotomy for Hall Insulators on the Lattice
abstract: We prove the localization dichotomy conjecture for non-periodic Hall insulators on the lattice. That is, we show that the Fermi projector $P$ of a gapped exponentially local Hamiltonian on $l^2(\mathbb{Z}^2) \otimes \mathbb{C}^n$ admits an exponentially localized Wannier basis if and only if $P$ has vanishing Chern number.
summary: 我们证明了晶格上非周期霍尔绝缘体的定域二分猜想。也就是说，我们证明，当且仅当 $P$ 具有消失的陈数时，$l^2(\mathbb{Z}^2) \otimes \mathbb{C}^n$ 上的有隙指数局部哈密顿量的费米投影仪 $P$ 承认指数局部 Wannier 基。

title: Stability of Matter Interacting with Classical Non-Abelian Gauge Fields
abstract: Stability of matter is the property that the ground state energy of $N$ charged quantum particles is bounded below by $-CN$, with $C$ independent of $N$. We ask whether this holds for colour-charged fermions interacting with a classical non-abelian gauge field. The field is a dynamical variable on the same footing as the matter, and the energy is minimized over both. The charges are matrices, and every pair of particles has an attractive colour channel. Non-relativistic spinless fermions are stable for every value of the coupling constant $\alpha$. Relativistic spinless fermions and non-relativistic spin-$\frac12$ fermions are stable for small $\alpha$ and unstable for large $\alpha$. For Dirac fermions the choice of positive-energy subspace decides: with that of the full Dirac operator they are stable for small $\alpha$, with the free one unstable for every $\alpha$. Two species of bosons are unstable. In every case the outcome is the same as for electric charges, although essential steps of the abelian proofs fail. The key tool is an electrostatic inequality for matrix-valued charges, uniform in the field, which replaces the uniformly charged sphere of Newton's theorem by the surface charge of a covariant harmonic extension. The stability results hold for every compact gauge group, and most of them for non-smooth fields of finite energy.
summary:
物质的稳定性是指 $N$ 带电量子粒子的基态能量受 $-CN$ 限制，其中 $C$ 独立于 $N$。我们询问这对于与经典非阿贝尔规范场相互作用的带色费米子是否成立。场是与物质处于同一基础上的动态变量，并且能量在两者上都最小化。电荷是矩阵，每对粒子都有一个有吸引力的颜色通道。非相对论无旋费米子对于耦合常数 $\alpha$ 的每个值都是稳定的。相对论性无自旋费米子和非相对论性自旋 $\frac12$ 费米子对于较小的 $\alpha$ 是稳定的，对于较大的 $\alpha$ 是不稳定的。对于狄拉克费米子，正能量子空间的选择决定了：对于完整的狄拉克算子，它们对于小的 $\alpha$ 是稳定的，而自由子空间对于每个 $\alpha$ 都是不稳定的。有两种玻色子不稳定。在每种情况下，结果都与电荷相同，尽管阿贝尔证明的基本步骤失败了。

关键工具是场中均匀的矩阵值电荷的静电不等式，它用协变谐波扩展的表面电荷取代了牛顿定理中的均匀带电球体。稳定性结果适用于每个紧凑规范组，其中大多数适用于有限能量的非光滑场。

title: An unified approach for the (inverted) quantum harmonic oscillator and the Berry-Keating hamiltonian
abstract: We propose an unified view to three well known quadratic Hamiltonians widely considered in quantum mechanics, i.e. those of the harmonic oscillator, of the inverted harmonic oscillator, and the Berry-Keating Hamiltonian. We describe an unified approach to determine the discrete spectrum of these operators, and to deduce their (generalized) eigenstates. We also look at these Hamiltonians as the generators of $\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$, and of a generalized version of it relevant in presence of non Hermitian generators.
summary: 我们对量子力学中广泛考虑的三个众所周知的二次哈密顿量提出了统一的观点，即谐振子、反谐振子和贝里-基廷哈密顿量。我们描述了一种统一的方法来确定这些算子的离散谱，并推导它们的（广义）本征态。我们还将这些哈密顿量视为 $\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$ 的生成器，以及与非埃尔米特生成器存在相关的广义版本。

title: Conformal invariance of the planar four-state Potts model and its random-cluster representation
abstract: For the critical random-cluster model on $\mathbb Z^2$ with cluster-weight $q=4$, we prove the convergence of loops to CLE(4) in the scaling limit. Conformal invariance of the four-state Potts model is then deduced via the Edwards-Sokal coupling.
summary: 对于 $\mathbb Z^2$ 上聚类权重 $q=4$ 的临界随机聚类模型，我们证明了在缩放限制下循环收敛到 CLE(4)。然后通过 Edwards-Sokal 耦合推导出四态 Potts 模型的共形不变性。

title: Nematic order in monomer-dimer models of Heilmann and Lieb with lateral attraction in dimensions $d\ge 2$
abstract: We study the $d$-dimensional generalization of Models II ($d=2$) and V ($d=3$) for liquid crystals introduced by Heilmann--Lieb (1979), which consists of dimers on the hypercubic lattice at chemical potential $\mu$, interacting via a hard-core repulsion and a lateral attraction between parallel dimers with coupling constant $b>0$. For $d\in\{2,3\}$, these models were conjectured to exhibit liquid-crystalline order at low temperatures provided that $\mu+2(d-1)b>0$. We establish nematic order for all $d\ge 2$ under the additional condition $(4d-6)b>\mu$, which corresponds to the physical regime in which misaligned dimers are rare on scales comparable to the correlation length of the one-dimensional reference system. While the treatment of orientational order here follows the approach of our recent work on Model I, the proof of the absence of translational order relies on a custom implementation of cluster swapping in the sense of Sheffield (2005). Consequently, we deduce uniqueness of Gibbs measure and anisotropic exponential decay of correlations within each oriented phase.
summary: 我们研究了 Heilmann--Lieb (1979) 提出的液晶模型 II ($d=2$) 和 V ($d=3$) 的 $d$ 维推广，该模型由化学势为 $\mu$ 的超立方晶格上的二聚体组成，通过耦合常数 $b>0$ 的平行二聚体之间的硬核排斥和横向吸引力相互作用。对于$d\in\{2,3\}$，假设$\mu+2(d-1)b>0$，这些模型在低温下表现出液晶有序性。我们在附加条件 $(4d-6)b>\mu$ 下为所有 $d\ge 2$ 建立向列序，这对应于在与一维参考系统的相关长度相当的尺度上错位二聚体很少见的物理状态。虽然这里对方向顺序的处理遵循我们最近在模型 I 上的工作方法，但缺乏平移顺序的证明依赖于 Sheffield (2005) 意义上的簇交换的自定义实现。因此，我们推断出吉布斯测度的唯一性和每个定向相内相关性的各向异性指数衰减。

title: Exact Unitary Synthesis: Simultaneously Optimal in Size and Depth-Ancilla Tradeoff
abstract: Unitary synthesis underlies universal quantum computation by translating unitary transformations into circuits of elementary gates. We show that for any budget $m\geq 0$ of ancilla, every $n$-qubit unitary can be exactly implemented using a quantum circuit consisting of $O(4^n)$ CNOT and single-qubit gates in $O(n+4^n/(n+m))$ layers attaining the asymptotically optimal depth--ancilla tradeoff while simultaneously achieving optimal circuit size. The key idea is to encode computational basis states as wavefunctions sharing a Gaussian envelope, converting unitary action on amplitudes into coordinate transformations that admit shallow circuit implementations. The continuous encoding is then discretized, with approximation errors removed by exact residual correction. The depth-ancilla tradeoff follows by recursively applying the quantum Shannon decomposition, synthesizing its smaller unitary factors, and reusing ancillary qubits.
summary: 通过将酉变换转化为基本门电路，酉综合成为通用量子计算的基础。我们证明，对于任何 $m\geq 0$ 的辅助预算，每个 $n$-量子位酉都可以使用由 $O(4^n)$ CNOT 和 $O(n+4^n/(n+m))$ 层中的单量子位门组成的量子电路精确实现，从而获得渐近最佳深度 - 辅助权衡，同时实现最佳电路尺寸。关键思想是将计算基础状态编码为共享高斯包络的波函数，将振幅上的酉作用转换为允许浅层电路实现的坐标变换。然后连续编码被离散化，通过精确的残差校正消除近似误差。通过递归应用量子香农分解、合成其较小的单一因子并重用辅助量子位来实现深度与辅助权衡。

title: Black Hole Radiation Decoding in the Haar Random Oracle Model
abstract: We prove optimal query bounds for recovering a single qubit from black-hole radiation in the Haar random oracle model, when the remaining black hole contains at most one sixteenth of the system's qubits. Recovery with any constant Haar-averaged advantage over trivial decoding requires queries proportional to the Hilbert-space dimension of the remaining black hole. The lower bound is unconditional for decoders chosen independently of the sampled unitary, allows arbitrary computation between queries, and access to $U, U^\dagger, U^*, U^\mathsf T$ along with the controlled variants. An existing decoder using only forward and inverse queries attains a matching bound. The proof uses a path recording oracle to compare real and maximally mixed states. As applications, we obtain an efficiently preparable, statistically far, computationally indistinguishable (EFI) pair and quantum commitments relative to a public Haar oracle, as well as prove a tight linear rank lower bound for Uhlmann transformation on a fixed-target family.
summary: 我们证明了当剩余黑洞最多包含系统量子位的十六分之一时，在 Haar 随机预言模型中从黑洞辐射恢复单个量子位的最佳查询界限。与普通解码相比，具有任何恒定哈尔平均优势的恢复需要与剩余黑洞的希尔伯特空间维度成比例的查询。对于独立于采样酉元选择的解码器来说，下界是无条件的，允许查询之间的任意计算，并访问 $U、U^\dagger、U^*、U^\mathsf T$ 以及受控变体。仅使用正向和反向查询的现有解码器就达到了匹配界限。该证明使用路径记录预言来比较真实状态和最大混合状态。作为应用，我们获得了一个可有效准备的、统计上远的、计算上不可区分的 (EFI) 对和相对于公共 Haar 预言的量子承诺，并证明了固定目标族上乌尔曼变换的严格线性秩下界。

title: Kardar-Parisi-Zhang superdiffusion in chaotic quantum circuits
abstract: We construct a family of chaotic brickwork quantum circuits exhibiting superdiffusive transport with dynamical exponent $z=3/2$ in the full Kardar--Parisi--Zhang (KPZ) universality class. This is enabled by the equilibrium current associated with a inhomogeneous conserved density having a nontrivial dependence on the chemical potential. Using nonlinear fluctuating hydrodynamics, we derive the propagation velocity, broadening scale, and universal scaling form of the charge correlation function from microscopic equilibrium properties. Tensor-network simulations of a two-site spin-$1$ (qutrit) circuit reproduce these parameter-free predictions, including the full stationary KPZ profile. We further construct a three-site spin-$\frac12$ (qubit) circuit, where transport varies from diffusive to superdiffusive with the chemical potential, while long-lived coherent quasiparticles delay the convergence of the profile to the KPZ scaling form. Our results establish that KPZ superdiffusion in quantum systems is not restricted to fine-tuned integrable models.
summary: 我们构建了一系列混沌砖砌量子电路，在完整的 Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) 普适性类中表现出动态指数 $z=3/2$ 的超扩散传输。这是通过与不均匀守恒密度相关的平衡电流实现的，该不均匀守恒密度对化学势具有非平凡的依赖性。利用非线性脉动流体动力学，我们从微观平衡性质推导出电荷相关函数的传播速度、展宽尺度和通用尺度形式。两站点自旋 $1$ (qutrit) 电路的张量网络模拟重现了这些无参数预测，包括完整的静态 KPZ 轮廓。我们进一步构建了一个三位点自旋$\frac12$（量子位）电路，其中传输随化学势从扩散到超扩散变化，而长寿命的相干准粒子延迟了轮廓向 KPZ 标度形式的收敛。我们的结果表明，量子系统中的 KPZ 超扩散并不局限于微调可积模型。

title: Decoupling Spectral Gaps from Entanglement Complexity in Quantum Annealing
abstract: Exponentially small spectral gaps are the central obstacle to adiabatic quantum annealing, yet whether such bottlenecks demand correspondingly complex entanglement remains unclear. We show that gap scaling and entanglement complexity need not be linked. Conventional first-order transitions combine exponentially small gaps with bounded $O(1)$ bipartite Schmidt rank, even though the critical states retain global multipartite correlations, while continuous transitions combine polynomially closing gaps with logarithmically growing entanglement. We show that each pairing can also be inverted: in a known first-order transition in a staggered-field antiferromagnetic Ising chain the gap closes polynomially despite bounded Schmidt rank, while we construct a mirror-twin manifold model whose gap closes exponentially even as its entanglement entropy grows logarithmically with system size. We derive bounds connecting Schmidt rank to Hamming-space geometry, and identify manifold density and connectivity as the ingredients that determine which combination occurs. These results show that entanglement complexity alone cannot characterize annealing difficulty, and point toward a broader search for quantum resources that capture the geometry of state evolution in Hilbert space.
summary:
指数级的小光谱间隙是绝热量子退火的主要障碍，但此类瓶颈是否需要相应的复杂纠缠仍不清楚。我们表明，间隙缩放和纠缠复杂度不需要联系起来。传统的一阶跃迁将指数级小间隙与有界 $O(1)$ 二部施密特秩相结合，即使临界状态保留全局多部分相关性，而连续跃迁将多项式闭合间隙与对数增长的纠缠相结合。我们证明了每个配对也可以反转：在交错场反铁磁伊辛链中的已知一阶跃迁中，尽管施密特等级有限，间隙仍以多项式闭合，而我们构建了一个镜像双流形模型，即使其纠缠熵随系统尺寸呈对数增长，其间隙也呈指数闭合。我们推导出将施密特等级与汉明空间几何连接起来的界限，并将流形密度和连通性确定为确定发生哪种组合的成分。

这些结果表明，纠缠复杂性本身并不能表征退火难度，并指向更广泛地寻找捕获希尔伯特空间中状态演化几何形状的量子资源。

title: Connectivity Controls Variational Accessibility in Symmetry-Preserving Quantum Circuits
abstract: Designing expressive quantum circuits for the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) is a central challenge in simulating interacting many-body systems. Even symmetry-preserving (SP) circuits need not access the full many-body symmetry sector. We demonstrate this explicitly for the spin-$1/2$ XXZ and Hubbard models, where Hamiltonian-inspired nearest-neighbor (NN) SP circuits generate restricted dynamical Lie algebras (DLAs). While these restricted manifolds can accurately represent the ground state near the free-fermion limits, $J_z=0$ for XXZ and $U=0$ for Hubbard, interactions expose inaccessible many-body directions and severely limit VQE performance even at large circuit depth. Remarkably, a minimal modification of the generator connectivity can reconstruct the full orthogonal DLA within all relevant symmetry sectors studied in this work. For XXZ model, the addition of {\it only} one SP next-to-NN single-excitation connection triggers this dramatic reconstruction, whereas the Hubbard case requires a SP correlated double-excitation;--showing that the relevant connectivity can extend from the spatial lattice to many-body configuration space. This reconstruction enlarges the tangent space and accessibility of the energy-lowering Hamiltonian direction, leading to near-unit ground-state fidelity in VQE simulations. Our results establish a direct link between generator connectivity and variational accessibility and suggest a broader circuit-design principle: identify minimal symmetry-preserving generators that enlarge the accessible many-body space rather than increasing circuit depth alone. This perspective may have broader relevance for quantum many-body simulation at the interface of condensed-matter physics and quantum computing.
summary:
为变分量子本征求解器 (VQE) 设计富有表现力的量子电路是模拟交互多体系统的一个核心挑战。即使是保对称（SP）电路也不需要访问完整的多体对称区域。我们针对自旋 $1/2$ XXZ 和 Hubbard 模型明确证明了这一点，其中受哈密顿量启发的最近邻 (NN) SP 电路生成受限动态李代数 (DLA)。虽然这些受限流形可以准确地表示自由费米子极限附近的基态，XXZ 的 $J_z=0$ 和 Hubbard 的 $U=0$，但相互作用暴露了难以访问的多体方向，并严重限制了 VQE 性能，即使在大电路深度下也是如此。值得注意的是，对生成器连接的最小修改可以在本工作中研究的所有相关对称扇区内重建完整的正交 DLA。对于 XXZ 模型，添加{\it only}一个紧邻 NN 的 SP 单激励连接会触发这一戏剧性的重建，而 Hubbard 情况则需要 SP 相关的双激励；——表明相关连接可以从空间晶格扩展到多体配置空间。

这种重建扩大了能量降低哈密顿方向的切线空间和可达性，从而在 VQE 模拟中实现近单位基态保真度。我们的结果在生成器连接性和变分可访问性之间建立了直接联系，并提出了更广泛的电路设计原则：确定最小的保持对称性的生成器，以扩大可访问的多体空间，而不是单独增加电路深度。 This perspective may have broader relevance for quantum many-body simulation at the interface of condensed-matter physics and quantum computing.

title: Learning Disentangled Representations with Quantum Variational Autoencoders
abstract: Variational autoencoders are powerful representation learning models that map complex data into low-dimensional latent spaces, enabling the discovery of interpretable and disentangled factors. Such representations can facilitate the interpretation and controllable generation of data describing complex scientific systems.
